_comment: Cau hinh cho dub_all.py. Doi giong doc / font / style tai day, khong can sua code.
_tts_type_note: 0=Edge-TTS (online, giong theo 'voice' tung ngon ngu) | 3=OmniVoice chay tren GPU thue Modal (nhai giong nguoi noi / giong mau co dinh). Doi bang DOI_TTS.bat.
_giu_nhac_note: is_separate=true: tach nhac nen + SFX ra khoi giong noi goc roi long tieng moi de len tren, giu nguyen nhac va tieng dong. Chi tach 1 lan cho ca loat, chay song song voi buoc dich (log o logs/separate.log).
_backaudio_volume_note: Do to cua nhac nen duoi giong doc. Nhac nho qua thi tang len 1.2-1.6, nhac at giong thi ha xuong 0.4-0.6.
_uvr_model_note: UVR-MDX-NET-Inst_HQ_4 giu nhac sach hon nhung nang hon. Doi thanh spleeter neu may yeu hoac tai model that bai.
_translate_parallel_note: So ngon ngu dich cung luc o pha 1. Dich chi la cho API nen chay song song nhanh gan nhu gap N lan. Ha xuong 2-3 neu nha cung cap bao loi 429 / gioi han tan suat, dat 1 de quay ve chay lan luot. Dich chay song song voi render: may tu xem RAM trong, thieu thi tam dich it ngon ngu hon (moi tien trinh dich ~500 MB, de danh 1.5 GB cho render) nen may 8 GB khong bi do, khong can tu ha so nay.
_translate_stall_minutes_note: Dich 1 ngon ngu ma bao nhieu phut khong co phan hoi thi coi la treo: tu dung va thu lai (API dich qua tai hay bi treo). Dat 0 de tat.
_dub_stall_minutes_note: Long tieng + render 1 ngon ngu ma bao nhieu phut khong co phan hoi thi coi la treo: tu dung va chay lai (video dai hon so phut nay thi cho bang do dai video). Binh thuong 1 ngon ngu ~5-6 phut. Dat 0 de tat.
_telegram_notify_note: Gui bao cao ve nhom Telegram (cai token + nhom bang CAI_TELEGRAM.bat): "always" = luot nao cung gui: tom tat thoi gian + chat luong dich / giong (Whisper nghe lai) kem file zip log + ban dich | "errors" = chi gui khi co loi / canh bao / bi ngat | "off" = tat.
_translate_qa_note: Soat ban dich truoc khi long tieng: cau rong, con tieng Anh, sai he chu, lan chu thua cua AI. Cau rong (AI bo sot) thi dich bu rieng cac cau do; loi khac nhieu thi tu dich lai 1 lan; hong nang thi bo qua ngon ngu do (file o subs/_loi/, chi tiet o logs/qa-<ma>.txt).
_translate_glossary_note: Bang thuat ngu: truoc khi dich, AI doc ca phu de 1 lan, rut ra ten thuong hieu / ma coin / ten tinh nang (giu nguyen) va thuat ngu chuyen nganh (dich thong nhat tu cau dau toi cau cuoi), roi chen vao prompt dich moi ngon ngu. File o subs/_thuat_ngu/ (sua tay duoc, xoa subs/<ma>.srt de dich lai). Soat ban dich bao them cau bi mat thuat ngu phai giu nguyen. Chi chay voi kenh dich AI. Dat false de tat.
_translate_timing_budget_note: Nhac AI dich giu cau vua thoi gian phu de (theo toc do noi, ghi de bang "speech_cps": {"de": 18}). Mac dinh TAT: do thu (video MEXC, tieng Duc) ban khong nhac chi 3/98 cau vuot khung, bang ban co nhac, ma ban co nhac con cat mat y (mat chu USDT, mat ve so sanh). Buoc GPU doc lai cho vua khung (tts_fit_ratio) da xu ly cau dai.
_merge_fragments_note: Phu de goc hay cat doi 1 cau ra 2 dong phu de (vd "$37." | "53 for the first 27 months") -> ca 25 ngon ngu doc sai gia, cau cut. true = truoc khi dich gop cac manh lien nhau thanh 1 cau: AI dich ca cau, giong doc lien 1 hoi; phu de tren hinh van chia ngan toi da 2 dong. Chi gop khi phu de co cham cau. Dat false de giu nguyen tung dong.
_tts_concurrency_note: So cau Edge-TTS doc cung luc. Microsoft chan khi goi don dap: 10 cau cung luc thi ~40% cau hong. Cau hong van duoc doc lai tung cau mot sau do.
_dub_parallel_note: Chi dung voi OmniVoice (GPU Modal): so video render cung luc tren may nay. "auto" = tu chon theo may (RAM < 12GB hoac CPU < 4 nhan: 1; ma hoa bang card do hoa: 2; libx264 + CPU >= 6 nhan + RAM >= 16GB: 2; con lai 1). Dat so (1, 2, 3...) de ep. Edge-TTS luon chay lan luot.
_dub_prep_ahead_note: Chi dung voi OmniVoice: so ngon ngu chuan bi tieng truoc (ghep cau, nhac nen, do am luong ~1-3 phut) trong luc ngon ngu truoc dang render; van chi dub_parallel video ma hoa cung luc. Ngon ngu nao dich + tao giong xong truoc thi lam truoc. "auto" = 1. Dat 0 de tat (lam lan luot nhu cu). Thieu RAM thi tu cho.
_tts_prefetch_note: OmniVoice + giong mau co dinh: tao giong tren GPU Modal chay nen, ngon ngu nao xong giong la render ngay (khong cho du ca loat). So luot 32 cau chay cung luc = so GPU (toi da 8 theo max_containers). "auto" = theo suc render cua may: render 1 video cung luc -> 4 GPU, 2 video -> 8 GPU (GPU chi can nhanh hon may render, them nua chi ton tien khoi dong). Dat so de ep.
_tts_fit_ratio_note: OmniVoice: cau nao giong doc dai hon khung thoi gian cua phu de qua 1.3 lan thi doc lai tren GPU voi thoi luong dung khung (giong tu nhien hon tua nhanh). Chi doc lai cac cau do. Duoi 1.3 lan thi tua nhanh tren may (khong ton tien GPU): 10/2026 doi 1.2 -> 1.3 bot ~nua so cau doc lai (~10% tien GPU Modal). Dat 0 de tat.
_tts_shorten_ratio_note: Doc lai cho vua khung xong ma cau van dai hon khung qua 1.3 lan (luc render phai tua nhanh, nghe don — vd tieng A Rap 22/129 cau) thi nho AI viet ngan lai rieng cac cau do (giu y, so, ten rieng), doc lai, phu de tren hinh doi theo. Xem logs/rutgon-<ma>.txt. Dat 0 de tat.
_tts_qc_note: OmniVoice: Whisper tren GPU Modal nghe lai tung cau vua doc, so voi cau yeu cau (diem 0-1). Cau duoi tts_qc_min (doc sot, lap, sai tu, ra tieng am u) thi doc lai toi da tts_qc_retries lan, giu ban nghe khop nhat. Cau van lech ghi vao logs/qc-<ma>.txt de nghe kiem. Do 10/2026: cau tot 0.92-1.00; 0.75 bat ~3% cau, doc lai cuu duoc ~2/3 so do. Ngon ngu ma ca loat nghe ra lech (giong lo lo, vd th/hi voi giong mau tieng Anh) thi khong doc lai, chi bao. Dat tts_qc_min 0 de tat. Tat tu 10/2026 (do loi nho con lai van nghe hieu nho phu de, bot tien GPU); bat lai: 0.75.
_tts_spell_numbers_note: Ngon ngu doi so -> chu truoc khi OmniVoice doc (vd ["de", "fi"]), phu de giu nguyen. Mac dinh tat: do 10/2026 OmniVoice doc so dung o 15 ngon ngu, doi sang chu con co the sai ngu phap (cach, giong). Cach doc rieng cho ten thuong hieu / tu kho: sua phat_am.json.
_tts_speak_text_note: OmniVoice + kenh dich AI: dich xong moi ngon ngu, AI viet lai cac cau co so / tien / % / chu viet tat (vd $37.53, ISO 27001, GDPR) thanh dung cach nguoi ban xu doc to, bang chu, dung ngu phap. Chi giong doc dung ban nay, phu de giu nguyen chu so. File subs/_chu_doc/<ma>.json (sua tay duoc). Do 10/2026: khong co buoc nay OmniVoice doc sai gia tien o gan nhu moi ngon ngu. Dat false de tat.
_video_encoder_note: Bo ma hoa video. Phu de nhung cung nen moi video bat buoc ma hoa lai toan bo hinh, day la khau lau nhat. "auto" = lan dau tu chay thu vai giay tren may nay roi nho lai (videotrans/encoder_choice.json): libx264 (CPU) hoac card do hoa (h264_nvenc / h264_qsv / h264_amf). Card chi duoc chon khi nhanh hon ro ret (>= 1.3 lan) vi file to hon, kem net hon. Ghi ten cu the de ep, vd "libx264".
_video_preset_note: Toc do ma hoa cua libx264: veryfast nhanh gap ~2 lan slow. YouTube ma hoa lai sau khi upload nen slow khong dang. faster / medium = file nho hon nhung cham hon.
_video_crf_note: Chat luong hinh: so nho = net hon, file to hon. 20-21 hop de upload YouTube; 23 = file nho hon.
_cleanup_note: Xoa thu muc out/<ma> sau khi da co video trong final/ (video trong final/ khong bi anh huong vi dung hardlink).
_am_luong_note: Chuan hoa am luong ve chuan YouTube (-14 LUFS). Lam ngay tren tieng truoc khi ghep hinh, khong phai ghi lai ca video.
_translate_type_note: 0=Google (mien phi) | 5=DeepSeek chinh hang | 6=Gemini AI (can project Google Cloud da bat Billing, xem HUONG_DAN_LONG_TIENG.md) | 10=OpenRouter | 25=9Router (VPS rieng, doi bang DOI_MODEL.bat muc 10) | xem day du: uv run cli.py --list providers

subtitle_style._note: Don vi theo PlayRes 384x288 ma ffmpeg sinh ra khi doi SRT->ASS. Nhan 3.75 de ra pixel o 1080p.
subtitle_style._maxlen_note: Dat rieng theo ma ngon ngu se duoc uu tien hon cjk/default. Tieng Thai nam trong nhom CJK cua pyvideotrans nhung chu Thai hep gan bang chu Latin nen dung 32 thay vi 15.

_original_video_note: Them 1 video thanh pham tu video goc: giu nguyen hinh + tieng goc, chi nhung phu de goc (cung style voi cac ban long tieng). Dat enabled=false de tat. Khi chay --langs thi phai ghi them ma goc (vd: en,ar) moi lam.
_languages_note: Ten trong 'name' duoc dung de dat ten file video xuat ra. Bo tieng Anh vi do la ngon ngu goc. "omnivoice_voice": "native" = voi OmniVoice, ngon ngu nay dung giong nam ban xu (tao 1 lan, luu o f5-tts/omnivoice_native) thay cho giong mau tieng Anh — giong mau tieng Anh lam ms, fil bi lo lo giong Anh.
